cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Here's your new key. Come in now; I've made your favourite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. This key does both doors. Shall we try them before lunch gets cold?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood outside on my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get candles. You can let yourself into the kitchen while I find them.

mechanism: A treats its excluded visitor as a pupil relearning access and celebrations, pushing immediate closeness while sidestepping A lock change.
confusable: Not sincerely accounting for injury: A offers entry and birthday repair without admitting why B was barred.
comparison: Communication restart versus home access and delayed celebration.
seedUse: D85 key/both doors/lunch/birthday/candles; S05 house routine teaching used as redirect.
